title: Orsen and the Gravity
author: O. M. Blackwood
blurb: Lena Ishikawa, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
